verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 6.39
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 6.39

verses.pali: 4. Devatāvagga
verses.english: 4. Deities

verses.pali: Nidānasutta
verses.english: Sources

verses.pali: “Tīṇimāni, bhikkhave, nidānāni kammānaṁ samudayāya.
verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these three sources that give rise to deeds.

verses.pali: Katamāni tīṇi?
verses.english: What three?

verses.pali: Lobho nidānaṁ kammānaṁ samudayāya, doso nidānaṁ kammānaṁ samudayāya, moho nidānaṁ kammānaṁ samudayāya.
verses.english: Greed, hate, and delusion are sources that give rise to deeds.

verses.pali: Na, bhikkhave, lobhā alobho samudeti;
verses.english: Greed doesn’t give rise to contentment.

verses.pali: atha kho, bhikkhave, lobhā lobhova samudeti.
verses.english: Rather, greed just gives rise to greed.

verses.pali: Na, bhikkhave, dosā adoso samudeti;
verses.english: Hate doesn’t give rise to love.

verses.pali: atha kho, bhikkhave, dosā dosova samudeti.
verses.english: Rather, hate just gives rise to hate.

verses.pali: Na, bhikkhave, mohā amoho samudeti;
verses.english: Delusion doesn’t give rise to understanding.

verses.pali: atha kho, bhikkhave, mohā mohova samudeti.
verses.english: Rather, delusion just gives rise to delusion.

verses.pali: Na, bhikkhave, lobhajena kammena dosajena kammena mohajena kammena devā paññāyanti, manussā paññāyanti, yā vā panaññāpi kāci sugatiyo.
verses.english: It’s not because of deeds born of greed, hate, and delusion that gods, humans, or those in any other good places are found.

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, lobhajena kammena dosajena kammena mohajena kammena nirayo paññāyati tiracchānayoni paññāyati pettivisayo paññāyati, yā vā panaññāpi kāci duggatiyo.
verses.english: Rather, it’s because of deeds born of greed, hate, and delusion that hell, the animal realm, the ghost realm, or any other bad places are found.

verses.pali: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi nidānāni kammānaṁ samudayāya.
verses.english: These are three sources that give rise to deeds.

verses.pali: Tīṇimāni, bhikkhave, nidānāni kammānaṁ samudayāya.
verses.english: Mendicants, there are these three sources that give rise to deeds.

verses.pali: Katamāni tīṇi?
verses.english: What three?

verses.pali: Alobho nidānaṁ kammānaṁ samudayāya, adoso nidānaṁ kammānaṁ samudayāya, amoho nidānaṁ kammānaṁ samudayāya.
verses.english: Contentment, love, and understanding are sources that give rise to deeds.

verses.pali: Na, bhikkhave, alobhā lobho samudeti;
verses.english: Contentment doesn’t give rise to greed.

verses.pali: atha kho, bhikkhave, alobhā alobhova samudeti.
verses.english: Rather, contentment just gives rise to contentment.

verses.pali: Na, bhikkhave, adosā doso samudeti;
verses.english: Love doesn’t give rise to hate.

verses.pali: atha kho, bhikkhave, adosā adosova samudeti.
verses.english: Rather, love just gives rise to love.

verses.pali: Na, bhikkhave, amohā moho samudeti;
verses.english: Understanding doesn’t give rise to delusion.

verses.pali: atha kho, bhikkhave, amohā amohova samudeti.
verses.english: Rather, understanding just gives rise to understanding.

verses.pali: Na, bhikkhave, alobhajena kammena adosajena kammena amohajena kammena nirayo paññāyati tiracchānayoni paññāyati pettivisayo paññāyati, yā vā panaññāpi kāci duggatiyo.
verses.english: It’s not because of deeds born of contentment, love, and understanding that hell, the animal realm, the ghost realm, or any other bad places are found.

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, alobhajena kammena adosajena kammena amohajena kammena devā paññāyanti, manussā paññāyanti, yā vā panaññāpi kāci sugatiyo.
verses.english: Rather, it’s because of deeds born of contentment, love, and understanding that gods, humans, or those in any other good places are found.

verses.pali: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi nidānāni kammānaṁ samudayāyā”ti.
verses.english: These are three sources that give rise to deeds.”

verses.pali: Navamaṁ.
